src.notebooks.DataLoader.__dataset_cleaner_aux(data: list[tuple[str, str, numpy.ndarray]], max_length: int) → list[tuple[str, str, numpy.ndarray]]

Aux function to clean the dataset. It will split elements with more than max_length frames and extend the ones that are smaller than max_length frames. It will also remove elements with less than 10 frames. New elements will be created with the same label and a new filename. The new filename will be the original filename + “-1”, “-2”, etc.

Args:

data (list[tuple[str, str, np.ndarray]]): original data max_length (int): max number of frames

Returns:

list[tuple[str, str, np.ndarray]]: list of standarized animations
